# Linea Jewelry

> Minimalist jewelry crafted for the modern individual.

Linea is an online jewelry store offering curated collections of rings, necklaces, earrings, and bracelets. All pieces are designed with a focus on clean lines, contemporary aesthetics, and timeless elegance.

## Products

- Rings: Minimalist bands and statement rings in gold, silver, and mixed metals
- Necklaces: Delicate chains and pendants with geometric and organic forms
- Earrings: Studs, hoops, and drop earrings with sculptural details
- Bracelets: Chain bracelets and cuffs with architectural inspiration
